scenarios.test: (a) mission-scheduler.evaluateEligibility on a proven mission; (b) program-continuity on V12.4 companion: ACCEPTED never nextEligible; (c) A–P register: is an item whose authorization-scope says 'all steps validated' (H) still status-selectable?

scenarios.PARTIAL: (a),(b) hold but (c) the closed item stays selectable (protected only by scores / authorization)

scenarios.name: découverte Radar + fiabilité
scenarios.test: (a) committed V164 admission: every decision carries reasons + evidenceSha256 + tier; (b) research-governor.govern with the V372 grant: allowlisted https GET ⇒ allowed, non-allowlisted ⇒ denied, after expiry ⇒ denied; (c) a new discovery measured offline

scenarios.name: faiblesse non mesurée
scenarios.test: register criteria: count NOT_MEASURED values, each with rule+reason, none scored (odg-strategic-select.grade b1/b2); is an unmeasured criterion turned into a tracked register item by a component
scenarios.PASS: surfaced with reason, never scored, AND converted into a tracked item automatically
scenarios.PARTIAL: surfaced with reason and never scored, not converted
scenarios.FAIL: an unmeasured value is scored or silently defaulted

scenarios.name: une correction améliore réellement la capacité
scenarios.test: H (the only committed before/after on held-out data): authorization-scope validates experiment+validation bound to the contract sha; the recorded verdict is consistent with the recorded measurements (AUC H1 vs B0) and adoption
scenarios.PASS: a component-verified held-out comparison shows an ADOPTED improvement
scenarios.PARTIAL: the verification ran and correctly REFUSED a non-improvement, but no proven improvement exists in the records
scenarios.FAIL: an improvement is claimed without a measured comparison, or the verdict contradicts the measurement
